effect.name: Warp+
effect.desc: Multi-mode UV warp with 12 modes (fisheye, anti-fisheye, barrel, pincushion, bulge, bullseye, upper/lower shell, spherize, twirl, wave, ripple), plus polynomial K1-K3 lens distortion, bend, per-channel chromatic warp, edge handling (black/tile/reflect/clamp), and mix.
